title: Configuration and design-rule-check console
summary: Created application tooling that exposes configuration logs and design-rule-check results to engineers.

dates.note: First inspected milestone: 2022-03-30. See facts for earlier/later feature stages; this is neither proof of first-ever work nor a formal role/leadership start or shipped release date.

facts.text: Created Interconnect Architect's application console/logger for displaying configuration logs and design-rule-check results.
Integrated report-script execution, stdout/stderr capture and live build output across the Angular, Electron and Python application boundary.
Fixed executable Python command generation across the JavaScript/Python boundary, serializing nulls, booleans, nested containers, strings and numeric special values as Python literals.
Extended console/report integration with engine log capture, command-stream reporting and subprocess stdout/stderr/status handling.
Command serialization deliberately substitutes None for circular/unsupported values; it is not a general lossless object-graph serializer.

notes: Console creation is associated with the original NCI tooling; exact creation date is unspecified.

2026-10-27 local Git/source research supplements prior evidence. Authorship supports attributable implementation; shared components and later colleague changes retain separate ownership. No employer tests were rerun.
